name: Fast EMA + MACD + RSI Scalping Strategy (1min)
description: Long: Price above EMA200 + MACD signal line cross up + RSI(7) crosses above 60. Exit on MACD cross down, EMA9 break, or RSI overbought (75). Short: inverse with RSI oversold exit (25).

conditions.comment: Price above EMA 200 - aligns with larger timeframe
MACD signal line crosses up - bullish momentum
RSI(7) crosses above 60 - move already underway
MACD signal line crosses down - momentum flip
RSI(7) crosses down from 75 - overbought exit
Price below EMA 200 - aligns with larger timeframe
MACD signal line crosses down - bearish momentum
RSI(7) crosses below 40 - move already underway
MACD signal line crosses up - momentum flip
RSI(7) crosses up from 25 - oversold exit
